data.close_reason: Intended behavior, not a defect. A blocked ticket is deliberately not claimable: AGENTS.md:129-131 names blocked in the not-claimable set; AGENTS.md:132-133 documents claim as moving an OPEN ticket; claimability.py's docstring states the rejection as settled premise; docs/plan-review-gate.md:45-49 gives the rationale (a prerequisite closing may move both plan material and codebase, so a review certified against a blocked ticket cannot hold); and the workflow hands out READY work per AGENTS.md:120. The sanctioned path is to resolve the blocker. The investigating agent's widening of claim was reverted unlanded as creation rather than restoration.
